北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 晴朗但严寒，体感 -9℃，记得裹严实些，注意保暖防冻哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Sunny but bitterly cold, feels like -9℃. Bundle up warm and stay protected from the chill!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阳光好，但体感 0℃。出门别忘添衣，暖暖和和最重要！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny, but it feels like 0℃. Don't forget to add layers when you go out, staying warm is key!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感 0℃。体感有点凉，多穿点，别着凉啦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy, feels like 0℃. It's a bit chilly, so dress warmly to avoid catching a cold!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光不错，但北风微凉。记得添件薄外套，保持舒爽哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny, but a slight north wind makes it cool. Remember a light jacket to stay comfortable!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阳光普照，体感 13℃。天气舒适，但早晚温差大，别着凉！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny with a comfortable 13℃. Enjoy the pleasant weather, but mind the morning/evening chill!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州晴好，体感 0℃。地面温度低，注意脚部保暖，多喝水！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is clear, feels like 0℃. Ground temperature is low, keep your feet warm and hydrate!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京多云，体感 -3℃。有点冻手冻脚，出门戴手套，穿厚袜哦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy, feels like -3℃. It's quite nippy, wear gloves and thick socks when you go out!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，湿度大。体感 5℃，湿冷感强，多穿几层才暖和！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy with high humidity. Feels like 5℃, wear layers to combat the damp chill!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉晴朗，体感 0℃。虽然有阳光，但还是冷，小心别感冒了！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is sunny, feels like 0℃. Despite the sun, it's still cold, be careful not to catch a cold!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，体感 0℃，湿度低。注意皮肤补水，保暖是关键！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is clear, feels like 0℃ with low humidity. Hydrate your skin, staying warm is key!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有霾，体感 9℃。出门注意防护，呼吸清新空气很重要！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is hazy, feels like 9℃. Take precautions when going out, fresh air is important!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨大雾且极寒，体感 -31℃。全副武装，注意防滑，安全第一！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is foggy and extremely cold, feels like -31℃. Bundle up completely, watch your step, and stay safe!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -31℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云，体感 -20℃。户外活动注意防寒，戴好帽子手套！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy, feels like -20℃. For outdoor activities, beware of the cold, wear a hat and gloves!
沈阳.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -20℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，风力 4级。风大体感凉，记得添衣，小心着凉哦！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy with a 4-level wind. It feels cool due to the wind, remember to add layers and stay warm!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴朗但风力 6级。风大体感冷，注意防风保暖，谨防感冒！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is clear but windy with a level 6 wind. It feels cold, so protect yourself from the wind and stay warm to avoid colds!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感 -7℃。户外活动记得多穿，小心海风侵袭！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy, feels like -7℃. Remember to dress warmly for outdoor activities, and beware of the sea breeze!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 -10℃。海边风大更冷，帽子围巾不能少哦！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels like -10℃. The seaside wind makes it colder, don't forget your hat and scarf!
